Name: OwnedShelf
Author: RedoClouds
Description:
OwnedShelf gives you a searchable, read-only overview of items in your backpack, ordinary player chests and fridges across loaded locations.

Features
- Search by item name, qualified item ID, quality label or location.
- See matching item totals grouped by item ID and quality.
- Find the containers and locations holding those items.
- Open only when needed with F7; no always-on bar.
- On-demand snapshots with clearly marked partial results when scan limits are reached.
- Configurable shortcut and current-location or loaded-location scope.
- Read-only operation: no item transfers, item creation, chest changes or save writes.

Requirements
Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer on desktop. No other mod is required.

Installation
Extract the OwnedShelf folder from the ZIP into the game's Mods folder and launch through SMAPI.

How to use
Press F7 while free in the world to open or close the overview. Type to filter results. Use Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown or the mouse wheel to scroll. Enter refreshes the snapshot; Escape closes it. The world is not paused while the overview is open.

For localized names or longer queries, type ownedshelf <search text> in the SMAPI console.

Settings
OpenKey changes the shortcut. AllLoadedLocations defaults to true; set it to false in config.json for your backpack and current location only.

Storage scope
Ordinary player chests, fridges and loaded building interiors are supported. Per-player chest contents are read through GetItemsForPlayer. Unrecognized storage supplied through other mods' private APIs is not included. Refresh after moving items elsewhere.

Uninstall
Remove the OwnedShelf folder. No world content is added.

Credits and disclosure
Created for Quicksan. Code and release text were generated using AI tools; the original project logo is AI-generated promotional art. This release is Alpha.

If you see any bugs or problems, please report them through this project's Bugs or Posts tab so we can fix them. Feature requests and suggestions for improvements are welcome too.
